items.label: Weather-Resistant Outdoor Wall Lanterns
items.value: Constructed with a sturdy metal frame and thickened glass panel, this outdoor wall sconce is waterproof and built to withstand sun, rain, snow, and ice. The high-quality metal helps prevent rust and corrosion, making it suitable for long-term outdoor use.

items.label: Modern Matte Black Wall Light Fixture
items.value: Featuring clean lines and a matte black finish, this exterior wall lamp delivers a simple yet classy look. The clear glass shade enhances the modern style while allowing bright light output to illuminate your home’s exterior.

items.label: Wide Application for Indoor & Outdoor Use
items.value: Designed with a minimalist style, these modern wall sconces complement various décor styles whether the lights are on or off. Ideal for garage, porch, patio, front door, entryway, hallway, corridor, backyard, and other indoor or outdoor spaces.

items.label: Recommended E26 Bulbs
items.value: This 2-pack outdoor light fixture requires E26 base bulbs (100W max, bulbs not included). Compatible with LED, CFL, incandescent, and halogen bulbs. ST58 or ST64 Edison-style bulbs are recommended for a more decorative appearance.

items.label: Easy Installation & Maintenance
items.value: The open-bottom design allows for easy bulb replacement and cleaning. The glass shade comes pre-assembled, and all necessary mounting hardware is included for quick installation.
